## Summary

APTIV SERVICES US, LLC is the registrant name, at 5725 Innovation
Drive, Troy, Michigan, of four MA-L blocks in the IEEE registry [2].
Aptiv began in 1994 as General Motors' Automotive Components Group,
was renamed Delphi Automotive Systems in 1995 and spun off by GM in
1999, and took the name Aptiv in December 2017 after spinning off
Delphi Technologies; the listed Aptiv PLC is organised in Jersey, is
tax resident in Schaffhausen, Switzerland, and moved its headquarters
there in January 2025 [1]. The company makes
vehicle electronics, systems, modules and components [1], and its
digital cockpit line advertises full-cabin Android-based infotainment
with over-the-air updates [3].

The sources consulted do not say which Aptiv product carries a MAC
from these blocks, nor which radios it has, so those fields are left
empty rather than guessed [1][3]. An NVD keyword search for Aptiv
returned only an unrelated WordPress plugin, so no security note is
recorded [4]. The FCC ID databases refused the session that wrote this
entry, so no grantee code or silicon is listed.
